name: panes
description: Put your agents to work in real Excel, PowerPoint and Windows apps.
long_description: Connect a compatible desktop agent to Panes Windows computers through 18 MCP tools: commands, screenshots, mouse and keyboard, file transfer and a private viewer. Installing this bundle starts only the local connection. Creating or running a cloud computer uses your Panes prepaid credit. Give your agent a budget and stop computers when finished. Office tasks use the Office-installed template and your own Office sign-in.

api_key.title: Panes API key
api_key.description: Create an API key in your Panes dashboard. Your agent uses this key to control your computers.
